custom_secret.note: the compiler deinterleaved the default secret into an even-qword constant set and an odd-qword constant set; each 16-byte stack chunk interleaves one +seed qword from the even set with one -seed qword from the odd set (punpcklqdq/punpckhqdq), which is why the source addresses are not address-ordered. The default secret values are the qwords read at those sources.
custom_secret.rule: custom qword i = default qword i + seed for even i, default qword i - seed for odd i (all mod 2^64); built only on the seed != 0 path
